messages:
maria: Pen-test kickoff — incoming assessor access window next Tue. Need a secure reading-room flow: ephemeral creds, S3 evidence bucket, KMS decrypt policy, and an audit trail. Who can own evidence ingestion + RBAC whitelist?

samir: I can own ingestion. Quick Q: do we give the assessor an ephemeral IAM role or hand out KMS-encrypted keys? I prefer ephemeral roles + scoped kms:Decrypt for the `alias/pt-ingest` key.

devon: We have a staging cluster that the assessor will use. Need to confirm VPC peering for the reading-room and a hardened bastion. Also: enable admin API audit logging (CloudTrail) for 30d retention.

ashley: Ops note: I can create a temporary RBAC exception for `pen-test-assessor` with `storage.read` + `kms:Decrypt` on `alias/pt-ingest`. Proposed window: 2024-07-12 09:00-17:00 PT. Will scope by session policy. :calendar:

tyler: Add me for retest handoff. Also, evidence upload convention: S3 path `s3://redwood-pt/evidence/<assessor-id>/` with SSE-KMS using `alias/pt-ingest`. Document that in runbook.

maria: Samir — can you paste the ingest lambda env and retention policy? Need to demonstrate chain-of-custody and CloudTrail events for KMS decrypts.

samir: Sure. Quick lambda env snippet:
```
S3_BUCKET=redwood-pt
KMS_KEY_ALIAS=alias/pt-ingest
RETENTION_DAYS=90
```
Lambda tags objects with `pt:assessor_id` and emits CloudTrail events + object metadata. Will also sign manifest.json on ingest.

monitor-bot: Alert: baseline config check shows CloudTrail management events disabled in eu-west-1 — please enable before the window.

devon: :eyes: We'll enable management events in eu-west-1. Also will rotate bastion keypair and push a hardened AMI. Scheduling a 30m maintenance at 06:30 UTC before the window.

ashley: On RBAC details: I'll create policy `PT_Assessor_ReadOnly` with explicit denies for `iam:CreatePolicy`, `iam:PutRolePolicy`, etc. Will post the policy ARN when ready.

samir: One more operational question: do we allow the assessor to run their exploit scripts on GPU nodes or sandbox CPU nodes? We should restrict to non-prod compute with no DB creds.

maria: No production DB access allowed. Add an egress rule that limits network to internal subnets only. Also we need an evidence checklist for retest: proof-of-fix, deployment commit hash, and logs showing exploit attempts and failures.

tyler: For retest scheduling, propose a 2-hour block on the Friday following the window. Ops-oncall + Maria + assessor rep should attend.

devon: I'll upload the inventory and a short checklist to #eng-security pinned doc. Runbook snippet below:
```
1) Grant ephemeral role to assessor
2) Confirm CloudTrail + KMS Decrypt events recorded
3) Collect evidence bundle + manifest.json
4) Request retest slot via security portal
```

maria: :thumbsup: Great. Samir — can you confirm lambda deploy by EOD tomorrow and attach a manifest.json example? Also ping @ops-oncall so they can stand by.

samir: On it. Example manifest.json I will use on ingest:
```
{
  "assessor_id": "ACME-007",
  "files": ["scan.log","exploit-trace.json"],
  "signed_by": "assessor@acme.com"
}
```

ops-oncall: ack — will standby for handoff. Post-window we will snapshot CloudTrail + S3 object versions and then revoke the assessor role.

maria: Perfect. I'll draft the access matrix and share with the assessor plus security PO. Thanks everyone.
